PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES ACT 1988

PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES

(MEASURES WITHIN INFECTED LOCAL AREAS) (RECOVERY MOVEMENT CONTROL)

(NO. 3) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 11(2) of

the Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases Act 1988 [Act 342],

the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Prevention and Control of

Infectious Diseases (Measures within Infected Local Areas) (Recovery Movement

Control) (No. 3) (Amendment) Regulations 2021.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 10 March 2021.

New regulation 7A

2. The Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases (Measures within

Infected Local Areas) (Recovery Movement Control) (No. 3) Regulations 2021

[P.U. (A) 98/2021], which are referred to as the "principal Regulations" in these

Regulations, are amended by inserting after regulation 7 the following regulation:

"Movement for purpose of touring

7A. (1) A person may move for the purpose of touring activity to any place

within the infected local areas specified in column (1) of the First Schedule subject

to any conditions determined by the Director General from time to time as

published in the official website of the National Security Council.

(2) For the State of Sabah, a person may move for the purpose of touring

activity to any place within the zone specified in the Second Schedule subject to

any conditions determined by the Director General from time to time as published

in the official website of the National Security Council.".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

APPLICATION

[Regulation 2]

(1)

Infected Local Area/Division/District

(2)

Period

1. State of Malacca 5.3.2021 – 18.3.2021

2. State of Pahang 5.3.2021 – 18.3.2021

3. State of Perlis 5.3.2021 – 18.3.2021

4. State of Sabah except Nabawan District 5.3.2021 – 18.3.2021

5. State of Terengganu 5.3.2021 – 18.3.2021

6. Federal Territory of Putrajaya 5.3.2021 – 18.3.2021

7. Federal Territory of Labuan 5.3.2021 – 18.3.2021

8. Langkawi District, State of Kedah 10.3.2021 – 18.3.2021".

Made 10 March 2021

[KKM.600-29/4/146 Jld.2 (30); PN(PU2)470/Jld. 5]
